summary: The Application file is part of a user control for managing eTopics within a web application. It involves a wizard control that guides the user through different configuration steps related to disciplines, sites, services, and destinations.
purpose: To manage the configuration and assignment of eTopics within a web application, allowing users to set preferences for disciplines, sites, services, and destinations through a series of wizard steps.

workflows.name: ETopic Application Setup
steps: Set disciplines, sites, services, and destinations
Save configuration on Wizard finish button

business_rules: If uxAllowAllSites, uxAllowAllServices or uxAllowAllDestinations is set to '1', respective configuration lists are not enabled.
The system manages the application of all, none, or selected disciplines, sites, services, and destinations.
validations: Validate if selected disciplines, sites, services, and destinations are part of allowed lists.
Ensure UX controls are enabled only when the screen is editable.
conditions: If uxAllowAllDisciplines, uxAllowAllSites, uxAllowAllServices, or uxAllowAllDestinations is '0', set up respective configurations.
Use UserID field to store ETopicID for allowed user services.
system_behavior: Updates user session cache on application saving.
Redirects user to current page with updated query parameters after saving changes.
Handles AJAX postbacks and script registration dynamically.
